change: Fabric MCP 1.4.0 renamed docs_workload-api-spec to docs_item-api-spec and the required workload-type argument to item-type. Unknown parameters are now explicitly rejected. These real hyphenated property names must be preserved; underscore aliases are not accepted. The selected workflow retrieves bundled public API documentation without authentication. The separate docs_workloads -> docs_list-item-types response rename workloads -> itemTypes is recorded as public provenance, not claimed as covered by this API-spec trial.
limitations: Bundled, public, account-free API documentation only. No live Fabric resources, authentication or write operations are evaluated.
The measured workflow combines a tool rename and a required hyphenated argument rename; the separate workloads/itemTypes response change is provenance, not a scored workflow.
Official Microsoft release images are pinned by digest and their vendor sourceversion labels are checked against the exact Git release SHAs.
Native tool schemas and responses are retained; no underscore aliases, schema narrowing or migration-specific adapter is supplied.
setup: Unmodified real historical server entry point. Read-only, network-disabled container, no host mounts or credentials.
